name: Shiomi Hikari
source:
Hajime's childhood friend and the main heroine. She calls Hajime "Hajime-chan". Both of her parents are scholars that travel around the world so they usually aren't home, so she eats at Hajime's house and feels like part of his family. She is a member of the handicrafts but why she joined is questionable since she is considerably clumsy with her hands. She has been in love with Hajime since she was little. Of the handicrafts members, she was the one that first knew about Hajime's incurable illness.

[Based on [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/タペストリー_-you_will_meet_yourself-]Wikipedia[/url]]
